statements.status_notes: The RedirectSlashes middleware from go-chi/chi is not registered in any of the influxdb v2 HTTP routers. Chi is used extensively for routing but RedirectSlashes is never called, so the open redirect code path cannot be triggered.

The advisory (GHSA-mqqf-5wvp-8fh8) covers github.com/go-chi/chi/v5, which is a distinct Go module from github.com/go-chi/chi (v4). The v4 module does not contain the vulnerable RedirectSlashes code path introduced in the v5 rewrite. Scanner match against the v4 module path is a false positive.
